visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a hand holding a triangular slice of a cooked banana pancake, showing layers of melted banana and chocolate. A male creator is inset in the bottom right corner, holding a yellow package of rice paper and gesturing with his other hand. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a wooden cutting board where several ripe yellow bananas are scattered; hands then peel and slice a banana into uniform rounds. (3) In a glass bowl, the banana slices are mixed with raw egg yolks using wooden chopsticks. (4) A flat grey frying pan on a portable stove is shown being greased with oil; the man then places a translucent circular rice paper sheet into the pan and pours the egg-banana mixture over it. (5) Dark chocolate discs are placed on top of the cooking mixture; another sheet of rice paper is laid on top and pressed down by the man's hands. (6) The man flips the pancake high in the air with a flick of the pan, catching it perfectly while expressing a shocked facial expression. (7) The finished pancake is cut into segments on the cutting board; the man takes a bite and reacts with delight, followed by a shot of him pulling a slice apart to reveal a gooey, stretchy interior. (8) He pours honey over the pancake and then eats another piece while standing in a kitchen with blue cabinets and a window in the background. (9) Finally, he stands holding bananas and the rice paper pack, speaking directly to the camera while gesturing energetically.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narration speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, upbeat electronic synthesizer beat with a steady kick drum. (2) Rhythmic 'tock-tock' sounds of a knife hitting a wooden board occur as he mentions banana slicing. (3) A soft 'ssss' sizzling sound is introduced as the pan heating phase begins. (4) As the creator flips the pan, a sharp 'whoosh' sound effect is synced with the movement. (5) Audible 'crunch' and chewing sounds are heard when he bites into the pancake, followed by a vocalized 'Mmm' and 'Oh!' of satisfaction. (6) The final section features the narrator quickly listing prices with rapid-fire delivery, ending with an emphatic 'zuo qi lai!' (make it!) accompanied by a final synth swell.
